## Summary by Sourcery

Integrate Cerebras as a new LLM provider across the system

New Features:
- Add ENABLED_CEREBRAS and CEREBRAS_API_KEY environment variables for toggling the Cerebras provider
- Register Cerebras in the model bank default provider list and export it in aiModels
- Define a full set of Cerebras models and include them in the model bank’s allModels export
- Implement LobeCerebrasAI runtime using the OpenAI-compatible factory and map it in the runtime provider map
- Add a Cerebras provider card for the UI including metadata, description, and links

ai_judgment.response: Yes. The issue involves adding Cerebras as an LLM provider, which falls under the category of "Unsupported models" in "Incompatibility with LLM providers," making it an agent issue.
